title: Grave Secrets - A co-op graveyard horror game in Godot (In development)
author: Bankaren
selftext:
**Your friend got framed for murder and has sent you a letter begging for help; the secret to the truth is hidden in the graveyard.**

So you and your crew sneak into a cemetery at night to dig up the evidence before the guards, ghosts or the hound sees you. Every run is a new seeded estate with 9 different areas, and each night you walk a different one: some have streams you can wade through (cold and loud), some have hills or mausoleums to hide behind. **You talk through proximity voice chat and the guards can also react to it, so whispering actually matters.** Getting caught drops everything you carried and you get dumped somewhere far away to find your way back. Getting caught too many times ends the game, it becomes more and more difficult (level 1-9). Each night is a bit closer to the center of the cemetery

Most work has been done by AI (as you can probably tell). I mostly playtest, complain and decide what goes in, and the trailer was recorded from the actual game with a scripted camera. Models are mainly CC0. It's still early and rough around the edges, but the style is also meant to be rough.

* **What elements should be added? More enemy types, better character models, more story between the nights, something else entirely?** Feedback welcome.
